note_en: 深受…喜爱 means "to be deeply loved by": in 深受摄影爱好者喜爱 "hugely popular with amateur photographers," the drones are the subject and the admirers sit inside the frame between 深受 and 喜爱. English needs a passive ("are loved by") or "popular with," but Chinese simply says the drones 受 "receive" the love. The same frame works with 欢迎 and 好评: 深受欢迎 "very popular."
